info.title: TrustRail API
info.description: Generated from the zod schemas that actually validate each route (packages/contracts and apps/api/src/routes/*.ts). See docs/API.md for prose (auth model, error envelope, rate limits). Regenerate with `pnpm generate:openapi`.

servers.description: Base path is /v1 for all routes except health checks and /.well-known/jwks.json.

AgentBearer.description: Agent credential: `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` returned once by POST /v1/agents/:id/credentials. Identifies exactly one agent in exactly one organization.

SessionCookie.name: trustrail_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /v1/auth/login or /v1/auth/register. Most session-authenticated routes also require the X-Organization-Id header (see the OrganizationId parameter).

OrganizationId.description: Organization the session's user is a member of. Required on every org-scoped user route.
OrganizationId.name: X-Organization-Id

get.description: Excludes revoked keys. Used to independently verify a receipt's JWS.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

200.description: Always ok, even if the session was already invalid.

post.description: Creates the org, makes the caller its Owner, and seeds a published default policy for refund.create/sandbox.

post.summary: Attach a role to an existing account (Admin+)
post.description: There is no invite-by-email flow in V1 -- the target user must already have an account.

403.description: Only an Owner may grant the Owner role.

404.description: No account exists for this email.

get.summary: Get an agent, including credential history

403.description: Not permitted to manage this agent.

post.summary: Issue a new credential (owner-of-agent or Admin+)
post.description: The secret is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.

403.description: Not permitted to manage this agent.

post.description: Immediate; the credential can never authenticate again.

403.description: Not permitted to manage this credential.

post.summary: Issue a grant (root: session Admin+; child: parent grant's subject agent bearer credential)
post.description: A root grant (parent_grant_id: null) requires a user session (Admin+). A child grant requires the Authorization bearer credential of the parent grant's own subject agent -- the server derives the issuer from that credential, never from the request body.

403.description: Not permitted to issue this grant.

422.description: Child grant is not a strict subset of its parent, or delegation depth exceeded.

post.summary: Revoke a grant and everything delegated from it (Admin+)

get.summary: List every policy bundle with full version history

post.summary: Create a new policy bundle slot with an initial draft version (Admin+)

409.description: A policy bundle already exists for this environment/action.

post.summary: Add a new draft version to an existing bundle (Admin+)

400.description: Bundle action must match the policy bundle's action.

post.description: Optimistic-locked: fails with 409 if expected_revision doesn't match the bundle's current revision.

404.description: Policy bundle or version not found.

post.summary: Predict the outcome of an action without reserving or writing anything
post.description: Same request shape as POST /v1/actions; runs the real evaluator, makes no reservation and no connector call.

200.description: Predicted outcome, not a transferable authorization.

post.description: The core endpoint. Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response is 200 if the decision resolved to a terminal state in this same call, 202 if still in flight, 409 for an idempotency-key conflict.

schema.description: Required. Same key + same payload replays the prior result; same key + different payload is a 409.

200.description: Terminal in this call (DENY, or ALLOW+succeeded/failed).

409.description: Idempotency-key conflict: same key, different payload.

get.summary: Read-only order lookup through the gateway
get.description: The agent never talks to the merchant directly; the gateway owns the connector credential.

404.description: Unknown connector or resource not found.

get.description: Dual auth: a session+org user can view any action in their organization; an agent (bearer) can check an action's status.

200.description: Full detail including delegation chain refs, approval, and linked receipts.

post.description: Atomic compare-and-set; a concurrent second decision gets 409 ALREADY_DECIDED. Rejects self-approval with 403. A since-superseded policy makes the approval APPROVAL_EXPIRED.

get.summary: List actions stuck in the unknown execution state (Approver+)

200.description: Items needing manual reconciliation, oldest first.

post.summary: Manually resolve an action stuck in unknown (Approver+)

409.description: Action is not in the unknown state; nothing to reconcile.

post.description: Deliberately unauthenticated -- verification must work for anyone holding a receipt.

200.description: Never collapses validity into one boolean.

get.description: Never a hardcoded number; an organization with no activity reports all zeros.

200.description: Aggregates over all recorded actions for this organization.

get.description: text/event-stream, not JSON. Implemented as short-interval polling of this organization's audit_events table. Each SSE `event:` is the audit event name and `data:` is JSON: {id, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, created_at}. Not representable as a normal OpenAPI request/response pair; documented here for discoverability only.

200.description: text/event-stream of audit events for this organization. See the operation description for the per-event shape.

post.summary: Run a demo scenario (Operator+, local/demo mode only)
post.description: scenario_key is one of: eur80_auto_refund, eur350_approval, eur700_denied, prompt_injection_deny, child_cap_rejected, root_revoked_denied, idempotent_replay, idempotency_conflict, receipt_tamper_detected, concurrent_budget_limit, connector_timeout_reconciled, direct_merchant_write_rejected, order_not_owned_denied, lea_onboarding_completed, lea_admin_invite_blocked, subscription_plan_downgrade_approval, subscription_feature_activation_denied. Only works inside the seeded Northstar Commerce organization.

403.description: Demo endpoints disabled in production mode.

422.description: Wrong organization for the demo lab.

get.summary: History of past demo runs (local/demo mode only)

post.summary: Clear this org's activity data (Operator+, local/demo mode only)
post.description: Clears actions/receipts/approvals/budgets/jobs; never identity/grants/policy. The authoritative reset path is `pnpm demo:reset`.

403.description: Demo endpoints disabled in production mode.
